verdict.summary:
The three sweeps hold up: no rejected coverage, no missed source, no unmatched task. 286 entries cover 222 distinct (run, task_id); every one is accepted_or_strong in all_tasks.jsonl.

Verified standard GLM-5.3 sources:
(1) Hosted: /lustre/fsw/portfolios/nemotron/users/hengyuf/swe-task/sft/teacher-rollouts-v2-20261025, results/glm-group-0..7.json + glm-pilot.json. 50 tasks, 252 slots, 251 graded (192 pass / 59 fail), 1 infra.
(2) Self-hosted: /lustre/fsw/portfolios/nemotron/users/hengyuf/swe-task/sft/glm-rollouts-sftv3-20261107, results/glmlocal-{hengyuf,baihe}-g0..3.json + 2 pilot files, with the hengyuf-g1-rec1 re-run merged into g1. 220 tasks, 1102 slots, 1099 graded (884 / 215), 3 infra.
(3) Self-hosted: /lustre/fsw/portfolios/nemotron/users/hengyuf/glm53-serve/e2e, root3 and root4 results/glmlocal-{safe14-x1,pilot}.json. 16 tasks, 32 slots, all graded (26 pass). All 16 are also in (1) and (2), so this adds no tasks.
Hosted covers 50 tasks and self-hosted 220; 48 overlap. Hosted-only: official1-scriggo syn-gomacro-cand-c01-c696c6ca and syn-gomacro-cand-c02-r1b3-ed535f70.

Checks (all 1386 slots, read-only):
(a) Model. Hosted http.jsonl calls go to inference-api.nvidia.com with payload model nvidia/zai-org/glm-5.3. glmlocal calls go to a 127.0.0.1 router, and backends-extra.txt lists no extra URLs. Every glm53-serve-roll-* rank0 log shows env vllm-0.33.0-pr60477, TP8xPP2, model models/GLM-5.3, served as glm-5.3. The pilots' dev server (logs/dev/s2-prod-pilot) has the same config. e2e root3 ran on job 21427782 (stock 0.33, TP16); root4 on job 21430755 (patched PP2).
(b) Prompt. Every terminal.json has 2 input items. The system prompt has the same normalized sha (dff63d0894e3) in every slot: opencode-1.17.11-default.txt (sha256 962fbf3c) plus the runtime env block, without the Kimi reason-before-action sentence. The user message equals the staged instruction.md byte for byte. T 1.0, top_p 0.95.
(c) Task identity. All 52 hosted, 223 sftv3 and all e2e staged task copies sha256-match exactly one inventory row (accepted_dir or task_dir). sftv3 tasks.json digests match 207 accepted_dir + 13 task_dir. The id collision syn-django-recurrence-cand-c05-r1b3-0df4afde resolves to pilot3-dateutil-rfc5545; the pilot4 copy differs in tests/instruction.
(d) Grading. Each status matches terminal.json (pass = evaluation_completed and reward 1). 4 graded fails are 3-hour agent timeouts and are kept as fails: hosted ibis-c03-r1b4 r4 and ibis-c05-r1b2-r2b3 r0/r1; sftv3 hengyuf-g3 ibis-c05-r1b3 r1.

Infra slots, all excluded from graded counts:
- Hosted: group-0 syn-wasmtime-cand-c03-353ec720 glm-r1 (attempts/5-1/attempt-2; SandboxPtyError, verifier SandboxApiException 410).
- sftv3, the user's 3 ungraded slots: hengyuf-g0 syn-litestar-cand-c01-r1b1-8f1b686c r1 (attempts/11-1/attempt-1), hengyuf-g0 syn-yq-cand-c05-cbe61bd7 r0 (22-0/attempt-1), hengyuf-g3 syn-goleveldb-cand-c01-r1b1-7523606b r1 (23-1/attempt-1). ATP ran the verifier (reward 0), but OpenCode never finished: opencode_finished false, generation-validity failure 'unknown', http.jsonl 0.7-1.2 MB.
- The infra-rerun1 re-run (rerun_infra.py and .sbatch, babysit/infra-rerun1, written 18:18-18:19) had no results/glmlocal-infra-rerun1.json and no probes/glmlocal/infra-rerun1-* at 19:08 PST on 2026-11-08.

Priority buckets over the 2,203 tasks:
- accepted_or_strong: 301 total, 222 covered (50 hosted), 79 uncovered (78 hengyuf, mostly official3/official4; 1 baihe, q21).
- partial 146, weak 350, none/unlabeled 1406: 0 covered.

Note: this workflow's own sft/glm-rollouts-tasksall-20261108/coverage.json (18:52) lists only the 50 hosted tasks, following the user's 'hosted' wording. Its make_tasks.py is documented to exclude the 220 self-hosted tasks.
